items.text: Rename DOTFILES_COMMIT_BACKEND/MODEL to DOTFILES_AI_BACKEND/MODEL, same values/defaults; qq and commit share them.
If new var unset but old set, use old value and print one-line stderr deprecation warning; new wins silently.
DOTFILES_QQ_TIMEOUT default 60s; commit keeps DOTFILES_COMMIT_TIMEOUT 15s; shared parser: empty/non-numeric→default, 0→no timeout.
New lib/ai.sh holds _dotfiles_ai_backend/_model, _dotfiles_ai_spinner_wait, timeout parser, _dotfiles_qq; commit-specific bits stay in git.sh.
`commit backend X` exports DOTFILES_AI_BACKEND; `commit status` also shows qq timeout.
qq prepends fixed terminal-concise instruction wrapper to the question; no env override.
Context-free: run backend from temp empty dir, tools disabled where supported; caller cwd unchanged; clean up temp files.
Update docs/DEVELOPMENT.md: renamed vars, deprecation fallback, DOTFILES_QQ_TIMEOUT, qq usage and limits (!word, leading space, piping).
Spinner/warnings/errors to stderr; stdout only the full multi-line answer, trimming only leading/trailing blank lines.
Errors: no manual fallback; not found/no answer exit 1, canceled 130, timeout 124, leading-space exit 1, with specified messages.
Bare qq shows `qq> ` prompt, reads one line via read -e -r; empty/Ctrl-D/Ctrl-C exits without calling backend.
alias qq='_dotfiles_qq #'; read question verbatim from `history 1` (HISTTIMEFORMAT neutralized); non-interactive uses "$*".
Leading-space guard: detect command not in history (HISTCONTROL=ignorespace), error, never send stale history entry.
No multi-turn, repo access, streaming, markdown, stdin input, qq subcommands, wrapper override, or !word workaround.
TDD bats: update commit/spinner tests, new tests/qq_command.bats, lib_modules type qq; run bashcheck, just test-unit, just test.
